snippet.title: Big Dig - Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Big Dig!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4304900/Big_Dig/

Big Dig is a short incremental game about digging up relics so Mayor Dog can build his highway. Build up your museum to earn money for new tools that help you dig deeper, dig faster, dig bigger! Mayor Dog's reelection depends on your work, and he won't let anything get in his way...
